I am old enough to remember when people used to believe every word of Sam’s bullshit (and to call me a “hater” for doubting him).


Andrew (@andrewmichaelio)

Sam Altman reconfirms that he has ZERO equity in OpenAI

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/andrewmichaelio/status/1658501431366647809#m

OpenAI: The Movie
Act I: ChatGPT sets records!
Act II: Sam gets fired, rehired
Act III: Greg’s diary blows it all up, in court.

Folks, AFAIK this is *literally not a possible outcome of the trial*, as Elon has waived the right to any cash payment to him, instead assigning any monetary damages to OpenAI’s nonprofit.


Noa Kt 🇺🇸 (@KtunaxaAmerika)

My prediction: Musk gets an eight figure check, nothing much changes



— https://nitter.net/KtunaxaAmerika/status/2051489314799026347#m

Too early to tell how the trial ends, but if Elon does win, the takeaway might be in part that Greg Brockman made two immense blunders:

1. Writing down all that stuff in his diary

2. Blowing off Elon’s offer to settle 

Stay tuned!


Gary Marcus (@GaryMarcus)

Elon: Let’s settle.
Greg: Nope.
Elon: Ok, let’s talk about your diaries, then.



— https://nitter.net/GaryMarcus/status/2051470991755526410#m

Elon: Let’s settle.
Greg: Nope.
Elon: Ok, let’s talk about your diaries, then.


keachhagey (@keachhagey)

On the eve of trial, Elon Musk reached out to Greg Brockman about a potential settlement, according to court documents filed by OpenAI last night. When Brockman suggested both sides drop their claims, Musk replied:

“By the end of this week, you and Sam will be the most hated men in America. If you insist, so it will be.”

The latest on the trial from @AngelAuYeung and Becky Peterson

wsj.c
Fleecing Elon: The Greg Brockman Diaries

“Indispensable reading”

If you aren’t reading my newsletter, you probably should be!


Zac Crippen (@ZacCrippen)

Today’s dispatch is on the Dawkins Debacle and cites @GaryMarcus, who has been indispensable reading over the last eighteen months. open.substack.com/pub/tfih/p…





— https://nitter.net/ZacCrippen/status/2051457328839262340#m

Hilarious (and maybe a little bit scary) that even in 2026 Marc Andreessen still hasn’t learned that LLMs don’t know how to reliably follow system prompts.


Silicon Valley Fodder (@Playerinthgame)

don't feel bad, guys, the techno-optimist manifesto guy doesn't understand what an LLM is either





— https://nitter.net/Playerinthgame/status/2051386307029438497#m

Greg Brockman’s diary is well on its way to being the most famous, impactful diary of the 21st century.


Alex Heath (@alexeheath)

takeaway from Greg Brockman testimony at Elon vs. OpenAI trial today is that no grown man should have a diary



— https://nitter.net/alexeheath/status/2051435261972853247#m

a question that suddenly feels relevant: what happens if OpenAI loses?


rubicon59 (@rubicon59)

I wonder what happens to OpenAI if they lose.



— https://nitter.net/rubicon59/status/2051402768272011528#m

Confirmed 2.5 years later, by Greg Brockman.


Gary Marcus (@GaryMarcus)

Remember how Sam Altman told the US Senate he had no “direct” investment in OpenAI? and how they gushed over his apparent selflessness?

👉He didn’t mention that (presumably) he had equity in YC which likely has equity in OpenAI.
And now this:
👉“OpenAI Agreed to Buy $51 Million of AI Chips From a Startup Backed by CEO Sam Altman”

#candor



— https://nitter.net/GaryMarcus/status/1731375497458987351#m

Way stronger.  Today was huge for Musk, bad for OpenAI.


Gary Marcus (@GaryMarcus)

The case against OpenAI is getting markedly stronger now that Musk is off the stand.

Why?

Musk’s lawyer is interrogating OpenAI founder Greg Brockman, making clear that OpenAI sold its mission as a nonprofit for public benefit, and not just to Elon but to many big figures in Silicon Valley, seeking *donations* to establish the company as a nonprofit.
